The commercial arrangement referred to above is in complete compliance with the extant regulations governing the FDI laws in India.4. All the business transactions entered and executed between the parties since 2009 are governed by the above referred commercial arrangement.5. Incidentally, all the business transactions referred above are executed in Indian rupees.This information may be deemed as disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

Chemicals is a part of separate company of course within KK Modi group only. Any proposal for any other consolidation / restructuring of businesses has not come to the Godfrey Phillips Board till date. If at all any such proposal is brought up before the Board and approved in future and is considered likely to effect the nature of GPI business materially, we shall inform the stock exchange accordingly".
